title: NoteForge AI
description: **NoteForge AI** is an autonomous **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** knowledge extraction engine that converts YouTube videos and audio streams into interactive **study notes, quizzes, flashcards, and mind maps**. Built with a hybrid routing architecture combining `Gemini Cloud APIs` and local `Ollama` models, it delivers zero-latency transcript slicing and resilient multi-key rate limit management.
longDescription:
### 🧠 Autonomous YouTube Knowledge Synthesis Architecture
**NoteForge AI** addresses the high cost and contextual latency of processing long video transcripts by implementing an **Enterprise Hybrid Multi-LLM Router**. High-complexity tasks—such as single-shot synthesis of flashcards, deep chapter study guides, and comprehensive quizzes—are routed to `Gemini 2.5 Flash`. Lightweight structural tasks—such as Table of Contents extraction and mind map branch reorganization—are delegated locally to `Ollama` (`qwen2.5-coder`), minimizing cloud API costs while maintaining instant responsiveness.

### ⏱️ Deterministic Transcript Slicing vs. Vector Overheads
Traditional RAG architectures rely heavily on expensive external vector databases (such as Pinecone or Weaviate) to retrieve relevant chapter context, introducing latency and risk of chunk boundary misalignment. NoteForge AI solves this through **Deterministic Timestamp Slicing**. By extracting native YouTube chapter timestamps and aligning transcript boundaries mathematically, the system isolates exact transcript segments with zero millisecond latency, zero computational overhead, and guaranteed contextual accuracy without hallucinations.

### 🛡️ Enterprise Hot-Swap Key Rotation & State Persistence
To handle unpredictable API rate limits during batch playlist processing, NoteForge AI features a **Round-Robin Multi-Key Pool** with automated exponential backoff powered by `Bottleneck`. If Key A encounters a `429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` error, the engine marks the key with an `exhaustedUntil` timestamp and seamlessly hot-swaps to Key B without interrupting active generation. Furthermore, job state and chapter progress are persisted locally via `Prisma` and `SQLite`, allowing interrupted jobs to resume instantly at the exact missing chapter.

### 🎨 Dynamic Headless PDF & Mind Map Render Engine
NoteForge AI provides print-ready document exports through an integrated `Puppeteer` headless rendering pipeline. The system dynamically injects customizable runtime CSS themes (**Modern Bento**, **Academic Serif**, **Corporate Blue**, and **High-Contrast Dark Mode**) with strict `page-break-inside: avoid` layout guards for inline code blocks and Mermaid diagrams.

challenges.title: Handling API Quota Exhaustion During Long Video Processing
challenges.description: Synthesizing 2-hour video transcripts frequently exceeded single API key rate limits midway through generation.
challenges.solution: Built a Bottleneck queue coupled with Prisma state persistence and round-robin key hot-swapping to guarantee uninterrupted resume capability.

challenges.title: Eliminating RAG Chunk Misalignment
challenges.description: Semantic chunking often split code examples and key concepts across arbitrary token boundaries.
challenges.solution: Replaced vector chunking with deterministic timestamp slicing using YouTube chapter markers to isolate complete logical sections.

learnings: Optimized cost-performance efficiency by orchestrating local Ollama models alongside cloud LLM providers.
Mastered headless PDF generation and page-break optimization using Puppeteer and dynamic CSS injection.
Implemented state machine resilience using LangGraph and SQLite workflow persistence.

architectureOverview:
### 📐 System Design & Core Architectural Engineering Analysis

**NoteForge AI** is structured around **Four Core Engineering Pillars** designed for autonomous processing, zero-hallucination context extraction, and high resilience under heavy token workloads:

#### 1. Presentation & API Routing Tier
- **Decoupled Client/Server Interface**: The React SPA frontend communicates with the Express backend via REST endpoints (`POST /api/generate`, `POST /api/mindmap`, `POST /api/quiz`).
- **Client State Management**: Maintains optimistic UI rendering while streaming chapter synthesis status over HTTP REST pooling.

#### 2. Hybrid LLM Routing & Inference Tier
- **Task-Based Dispatcher**: Routes single-shot flashcard and quiz synthesis to `Gemini Cloud API` while delegating lightweight mindmap transformations to local `Ollama` instances.
- **Rate Limit Cooldown Engine**: Utilizes Bottleneck queues to prevent `429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` spikes during multi-chapter video ingest.

#### 3. Deterministic Timestamp Chunking Engine
- **Zero-Latency Context Slicing**: Replaces vector database queries with mathematical timestamp boundaries extracted from YouTube chapter manifests.
- **Hallucination Prevention**: Guarantees transcript text chunk boundaries match exact video timestamps without semantic drift.

#### 4. Headless PDF Theme & Storage Subsystem
- **Puppeteer Theme Injection**: Dynamically injects CSS variables to produce print-ready Bento, Academic, and Dark mode PDF documents.
- **Prisma & SQLite State Persistence**: Saves chapter queue progress locally to enable instant workflow resume upon system restarts.
